newsitem.title: USA: Vinik cuts Consolidated Graphics stake.
newsitem.headline: Vinik cuts Consolidated Graphics stake.

text.p: A group led by former Magellan Fund manager Jeffrey Vinik said Friday it cut its stake in Consolidated Graphics Inc to 4.2 percent or 256,900 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it sold a net of 61,700 shares of Consolidated Graphics between December 6 and January 2 at prices ranging from $48.0067 to $56.965 a share.
Vinink's group includes hedge fund Vinik Asset Management and Vinik Partners L.P., which are based in Boston.
Consolidated Graphics is a Houston-based commerical printing company.
